## Community Coordinated Modeling Center Database Of Notifications, Knowledge, Information ( CCMC DONKI )
## Message Type: Space Weather Notification - Geomagnetic Storm
##
## Message Issue Date: 2024-05-02T18:50:40Z
## Message ID: 20240502-AL-005
##
## Disclaimer: NOAA's Space Weather Prediction Center is the United States Government official source for space weather forecasts. This "Experimental Research Information" consists of preliminary NASA research products and should be interpreted and used accordingly.


## Summary:

Ongoing space weather storm in the Earth's magnetosphere. Geomagnetic Kp index has reached level 6.67 (strong) during the synoptic period 2024-05-02T15:00Z to 2024-05-02T18:00Z. 

The storm is caused by the Interplanetary Shock with ID 2024-05-02T07:46:00-IPS-001 (see notification 20240502-AL-001).

NASA spacecraft at GEO, MEO, polar and other orbits passing through or in the vicinity of the Earth's ring current and auroral regions can be impacted.

Activity ID: 2024-05-02T15:00:00-GST-001.

## Notes: 

This event is associated with Magnetopause Crossing with ID 2024-05-02T15:49:00-MPC-001 (see notifications  20240502-AL-002 and  20240502-AL-003). The cause of the Interplanetary Shock is under analysis.
